correctness.rationale: The proof reconstructs the source definitions, prime-power values, quantifiers, and three exhaustive exponent patterns. The only additional lemma proves \(\sigma_k(a)/J_k(a)<\zeta(k)^2/\zeta(2k)\le5/2<J_k(b)\) for squarefree coprime \(a,b\) with \(b>1\) and integer \(k\ge2\), forcing strict positivity in the delicate cube-free nonsquarefree case. The remaining signs give nonzero values for all composites when \(t>-2\), while primes vanish identically and \(n=1\) yields the sharp boundary at \(t=-2\). The finite checker is corroborative only; no infinite conclusion is inferred from enumeration. Risk: no correctness gap was identified in the stated domain.

value.rationale: The question is naturally forced by the two endpoint criteria in the recent source. The answer is a sharp connected stability interval, not an arbitrary parameter slice: every \(t>-2\) preserves the prime-only zero set, while \(t=-2\) fails already at \(n=1\). The proof also extracts a strict positivity property in the source\'s delicate factorization case from an exact Euler-product bound. This gives reusable structural information about how the inverse-divisor-sum, Jordan-totient, and Möbius terms interact.
